evidence.finding: Fixed PoC source explicitly documents RECIRC cloning the skb, clone upcall failure and original OUTPUT; article correctly limits this to the PoC path. Side effects and the unreviewed prebuilt binary boundary are clearly disclosed.
evidence.source_claim: Doyensec article and fixed PoC tree

evidence.finding: Prerequisites and branch fixed-version matrix agree with CNA records: 89487/80977 share listed stable fixed versions while 90049 is later for 6.12, 6.18 and 7.2. evidence.independent_check: Fixed CNA snapshots show the affected start and per-branch unaffected versions; the 90049 record describes the guest zerocopy context. Doyensec describes the local namespace path requirements.
